messages.content: 你能為我繪製兩個正弦波嗎？第一個波的頻率應為5 Hz，從0弧度開始，到10弧度結束，振幅為2，相位差為1弧度。第二個波的頻率應為10 Hz，從0弧度開始，到20弧度結束，振幅為3，相位差為2弧度。

function.name: plot_sine_wave
function.description: Plot a sine wave for a given frequency in a given range. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_range.description: Start of the range in radians.

end_range.description: End of the range in radians.

frequency.description: Frequency of the sine wave in Hz.

amplitude.description: Amplitude of the sine wave. Default is 1.

phase_shift.description: Phase shift of the sine wave in radians. Default is 0.

message.content:
Sure! Here are the two sine waves plotted together:

```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# First sine wave parameters
freq1 = 5          # Hz
start1 = 0         # radians
end1 = 10          # radians
amp1 = 2           # amplitude
phase1 = 1         # phase shift in radians

# Second sine wave parameters
freq2 = 10         # Hz
start2 = 0         # radians
end2 = 20          # radians
amp2 = 3           # amplitude
phase2 = 2         # phase shift in radians

# Generate x values for each wave
x1 = np.linspace(start1, end1, 1000)
x2 = np.linspace(start2, end2, 1000)

# Compute y values for each wave
y1 = amp1 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * freq1 * x1 + phase1)
y2 = amp2 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * freq2 * x2 + phase2)

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(x1, y1, label='Wave 1 (5 Hz, amp=2, phase=1 rad)')
plt.plot(x2, y2, label='Wave 2 (10 Hz, amp=3, phase=2 rad)')

plt.title('Two Sine Waves')
plt.xlabel('Radians')
plt.ylabel('Amplitude')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
```

This script will generate a single plot containing both sine waves with their respective parameters. Let me know if you’d like any adjustments!
